Title: Amenra
Description: AMENRA will return to AB in 2027 for an exclusive series of concerts. These will be the first heavy metal shows of the year for the band from Kortrijk and, at the same time, their only Belgian gigs of 2027. For over twenty years, AMENRA have been developing their own distinctive sound, somewhere between post-metal, doom and sludge. Their music revolves around loss, pain and connection, characterised time and again by that intense alternation between subdued passages and crushing outbursts. Their concerts have since become a fixture at AB, where they have sold out several nights in a row in recent years. With frontman Colin H. Van Eeckhout, stark black-and-white visuals and impressive dynamics, AMENRA continues to deliver a unique live experience every single time.

Title: JAIN
Description: JAIN is back with Soul System, her fourth album, which is more direct, radical and incandescent than ever. For over 12 years, the French singer-songwriter has been cultivating a free-spirited brand of pop, fuelled by travel and experimentation. Blending electro, rock, funk and club music, Jain transforms dancefloors into playgrounds for exploration with an album that is free-spirited, sensual and fiercely alive.
